author: ChaseTheMeat
quote:
Gameplay can be fun for a bit, but unfortunately is immeidately ruined by whatever event the writers decided to put in. No characters being quirk chungus and having a panic attack when trying to pull them out is not a funny parody on the world, it's just annoying.

Many events you can reach within the first hour of gameplay are designed like easter eggs, but lack the subetly of what one would have. Instead of spending hours and going out of your way, they shove hulk and a giant crab down your throat. In what would've been a neat easter egg for people to start discovering a few months down the line, was sadly instead designed to be a farmable youtube clip, as most interactions in this game are.

The story is slow, lame, and timid, with nothing redeaming for any of it. The best ending in the game, is the "Bad Ending." Avoid until it get's pirated to pc in a week and modders can start fixing it.
